assistant_markdown:
Converted to a creature while keeping the high-impact, sacrificial
alpha-strike feel. I renamed it to Fervor Incarnate, added Creature —
Avatar, gave it haste and an ETB that mirrors the original spell, and
added power/toughness. Colors, cost, and overall “zealous” play pattern
are preserved.

modified_card_json.name: Fervor Incarnate
modified_card_json.text:
Haste
When Fervor Incarnate enters the battlefield, creatures you control get +4/+0 and gain haste until end of turn.
At the beginning of the next end step, sacrifice each creature that attacked this turn.
